description: What the Federal Reserve Board says, from its own feeds: the latest speeches and testimony by its members and its monetary policy releases (statements, minutes), with speaker, title, date, venue and link; one member's; or one speech read, its paragraphs on monetary policy and the economy quoted as given. A plain summary first. No key.

kind.description: speech, testimony or policy (the FOMC's statements, minutes and other monetary policy releases); default all three.

limit.description: Most items listed, newest first; default 15.

read.description: A speech or testimony page on federalreserve.gov (a link from the list): its paragraphs on monetary policy, quoted.

speaker.description: A Board member by surname (Powell, Waller, Bowman...): that member's speeches and testimony.

name: fed_speeches

outputSchema.description: rows are the latest items (newest first) in the order of columns; with read, rows are the speech's passages on policy, quoted.

title: Fed speeches and releases
